data.name: Sriram
data.gender_notes: Sriram is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sri: Goddess of Wealth and Fortune, Rama: Ruler of the People. The name Sriram carries the meaning “God of Wealth and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sriram usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for the divine ruler who bestows wealth and prosperity upon his people
data.etymology: Sriram belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wealth and Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sriram total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Sriram" is deeply rooted in Indian culture and holds significant importance in various regions, especially in the southern parts of India. It is considered an auspicious name for a child and is often used as a name for Hindu deities, mythological characters, and even for humans, symbolizing great virtue, power, and prosperity. The name carries a sense of prosperity, wisdom, and good living.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Sriram" is believed to invoke the blessings of Lord Rama, who is considered an ideal ruler, a model of dharma (morality), and a supreme manifestation of Vishnu. In Hinduism, Lord Rama is revered as the embodiment of pure love, courage, wisdom, and strength. The spiritual significance of the name "Sriram" is to constantly remember and be inspired by the life and teachings of Lord Rama. It is a reminder to pursue the path of dharma and live a virtuous life, bringing peace, prosperity, and happiness to oneself and to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sriram, meaning "Fortune of Rama," is a name that evokes devotion and prosperity. It symbolizes the divine presence of Lord Rama, who embodies strength, righteousness, and love. In Hindu mythology, Sriram is a reminder of the power of dharma (righteousness) and the blessings of the gods.
